long_biography.plain_text:
Lomakin trained in international finance and worked in Soviet chemical-export organisations before establishing International Potash Company. The business coordinated overseas sales for Silvinit, Uralkali and Belaruskali, giving him a central role in the post-Soviet potash trade. He later led the company and acquired an economic interest in producer Silvinit.

As producers changed their export arrangements, International Potash eventually concentrated on Silvinit alone. Lomakin and his partners sold their stakes in the producer in 2010, ending the core fertilizer ownership that had underpinned his fortune. He subsequently shifted from running a fertilizer exporter towards private investment.

uncertainties.detail: Anatoly is the established English form used by Forbes and Companies House. Russian Анатолий also appears as Anatoliy or Anatoli, while Геннадьевич appears as Gennadyevich or Gennadievich. The dossier proposes Anatoly Gennadyevich Lomakin and records the alternatives only as transliteration variants.

Lomakin's International Potash executive role and Silvinit ownership are historical. His and his partners' Silvinit stakes were sold in 2010, and the reviewed record does not support continuing ownership of Silvinit, Uralkali or Belaruskali.

Forbes last updated its statement that Lomakin owns 50% of Investstroy in April 2023. No newer independent ownership filing was found, so Real Estate and Investor are accepted above threshold but below very-high confidence.
